name: Yenikent Tunnel
facts: Yenikent Tunnel, a twin‑tube marvel on Turkey’s Black Sea Coastal Highway, stretches 1,598 m in one tube and 1,530 m in the other, offering two lanes per direction for seamless traffic flow.

Constructed by the Turkish Cengiz Construction Company, Yenikent Tunnel opened to motorists on 14 December 2012, a ceremony graced by Minister Binali Yıldırım, marking a milestone for regional connectivity.
Positioned just after the Gerze Tunnel when heading toward Sinop, Yenikent Tunnel forms a critical link on the Sinop‑Samsun Highway D.010, easing travel along Turkey’s northern coast.
